'''Vorn Zaday''' was a minor [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] dignitary in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], stationed aboard a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the war ended and the birth of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Vorn became skilled at [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], playing with fellow Federation officers until she became a finalist in the [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].
